newsitem.title: CANADA: Newmex, Santa Cruz in talks.
newsitem.headline: Newmex, Santa Cruz in talks.

text.p: Newmex Mining Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it entered into merger discussions with Santa Cruz Gold Inc.
Newmex said the two companies would create a Mexican gold producer with forecast annual gold production in the 100,000 ounce range from two mines.
The two mines would have total resources exceeding two million ounces of gold.
"A combined company would have three additional potentially economic exploration projects under development," Newmex said.
